verdict.rationale: The canonical llama-models GitHub repo has a per-family License and Model Card table covering Llama 2 through Llama 4, so the current flagship has a published card. The llama.com FAQ also points readers to the Llama 4 model cards. Community threads show the releases came with Meta's own benchmark and architecture materials, such as the included benchmarks and the 128-expert, 17B-active detail. Missing for 10: no evidence of what the Llama 4 card actually contains (training approach, evaluation results, intended-use sections), and the llama.com docs surface is behind a Meta SSO wall, which leaves the public GitHub repo as the only confirmed readable copy.
